title: Chapter 20 — Specialty Categories: Wine, Coffee, Outdoor
intro: Wine preservation, built-in coffee, outdoor kitchens, and the delight layer.

sections.title: The Delight Layer
sections.content:
Specialty appliances — wine storage, built-in coffee systems, outdoor grills and refrigeration — are not necessities. They are lifestyle products that create delight.

These products sell on wants, not needs. Discovery should uncover the customer's lifestyle: do they entertain? Do they appreciate wine? Do they live outdoors in summer? The answers point to which specialty categories to introduce.

sections.title: Outdoor Kitchens
sections.content:
Outdoor cooking and entertaining is a growing category. Grills, side burners, outdoor refrigeration, ice makers, and kegerators all require weather-rated construction and specific installation considerations.

Know which brands offer true outdoor-rated products versus indoor products marketed for outdoor use. The difference matters for warranty and durability.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating specialty category knowledge, ask:

Does the salesperson introduce specialty categories when discovery reveals a lifestyle fit?
Do they understand the difference between indoor and outdoor-rated products?
Do they sell these as lifestyle enhancements — not just additional SKUs?
